D01.body: Compare seven-day on-time completion for bicycle and van deliveries at North and South depots. This is an observational pilot, not a randomized estimate of the effect of vehicle type.

D02.body: Uncorrected export: North bicycles 23/60 and vans 21/70; South bicycles 20/50 and vans 24/60. The export may include duplicate bicycle completions. Do not treat these numbers as the final cohort.

D03.body: For deliveries enrolled from May 10, introduce electronic signatures. This policy does not change the outcome definition or denominators for the historic cohort enrolled May 1–3.

D04.body: Final deduplicated seven-day results for the May 1–3 cohort: North bicycles 18 completed out of 60, vans 21 out of 70; South bicycles 20 out of 50, vans 24 out of 60. Dawn-shift deliveries were excluded from this cohort, and no separate dawn-shift outcome comparison was collected. These counts supersede D02.

D05.body: Proposal only: recruit dawn-shift deliveries next month, stratify by depot and assess seven-day completion. No results or dawn-shift vehicle-effect estimate exist in the records through May 15.

D06.body: Logging took an estimated four minutes per delivery at North across eight observed shifts. Keep the current roster while planning a dawn-shift study. This is workload information, not a vehicle completion-rate comparison.

M01.body: Two systems, Ash and Birch, transcribed twenty typed catalog pages. Ash had 96% character accuracy and Birch 94%. These are character-level measures for the pilot, not release approvals.

M02.body: The owner permits display of three selected catalog excerpts on the exhibition wall. Permission is limited to those excerpts and does not authorize release of the complete automated catalog.

M03.body: A targeted, nonrandom audit of twelve pages found two omitted dates in Ash output. This sample cannot establish a corpus-wide omission rate. It does establish at least two date omissions in the audited output.

M04.body: The owner has not authorized complete automated-catalog release. Proposed full release requires written full-catalog permission plus checking and correcting names and dates on every page. Neither the permission nor completion of that check is recorded through May 15. Exhibition-excerpt permission is separate.

M05.body: On ten handwritten pages Ash scored 79% character accuracy with staff orientation help. Birch was not run because its license expired. The ten-page extension does not establish a handwriting comparison or authorize release.

M06.body: The three permitted excerpts are mounted with protective covers. Lighting measurements are pending. Installation of these excerpts does not add a release permission or a corpus-wide quality measurement.
